name: Level 1
notes: Each scene must be cleared by killing everything it sends in: its infantry, plus every vehicle and everyone riding in one.
infantry.count: street infantry sent in over the scene, in waves of waveMin..waveMin+waveExtra-1, every intervalMin..intervalMin+intervalExtra seconds, never more than maxAlive enemies alive at once.

events: vehicles that arrive at set points in the scene. 'at' is how much of the scene's infantry has been sent in by then (0 = at the start, 1 = after the last of them); an event that has to wait (one flight / one truck / one gun at a time) goes as soon as it can.

event types: 'cannon' (count guns, each with a crew of 2), 'truck' (troops soldiers aboard), 'aircraft' (count planes, each at its own height), 'gunner' (count heavy machine gunners: they run in from the left, set up where they have a line of fire and fire long, accurate bursts), 'launcher' (count tracked rocket launchers: they roll in from the left, stop and fire salvos of rockets that come down on the mech), 'zeppelin' (troops paratroopers: a vast airship hangs over the battlefield, only its belly in view, and drops them; it can be shot down, but only the paratroopers count toward clearing the scene).
kills needed to clear a scene = infantry.count + 3 per cannon + (1 + troops) per truck + 1 per plane + 1 per gunner + 1 per launcher + troops per zeppelin.
widthScreens: how wide the scene is, in screens (the camera scrolls through scenes wider than 1).
parTime: seconds a good player takes to clear the scene; the scene pays a time bonus against it (full at 60% of it or faster, nothing at 150% or slower).

boss: null for none, or { "type": "silos", "opensAfter": n, "truckEvery": s, "truckJitter": s, "truckTroops": n }: two missile silos that stay shut and unhurtable until n infantry have been sent in, then open together and launch missiles at the mech. A boss scene has no kill count: it ends when both silos are destroyed, and its infantry (infantry.count is ignored) keeps coming, with a truck of troops every truckEvery +- truckJitter seconds.
